requirements: docs/77 dashboards over the real usage ledger, SLO events and cost records
scenarios: a real Core with a signed registry and a scripted provider: GetDashboard for a session aggregates task states, tool outcomes, the IMP-EV-0032 usage ledger by model and by task (priced, unpriced and unreported calls kept apart), the IMP-EV-0023 cold/warm SLO figures, recent failures and provider health, and equals what the ledger and ladder report directly

the real Electron app's dashboard pane shows the Core's own numbers — tokens, cost, task rows, tool outcomes, model rows — the same the CLI `dashboard --session` reads from the same Core, and a refresh after a second task follows the log
on the cloud path the dashboard carries the task's cold start from the SLO ladder
tests: apps/desktop/e2e/dashboard.spec.ts::the operations dashboard shows the Core's own aggregation of its log, the same numbers the CLI reads
apps/desktop/e2e/workers.spec.ts (the typed bridge now lists dashboard)
audit: DOCUMENTED-ONLY: one task's economics in a banner; no session view of cost by model or task, tool outcomes, SLO figures, failures or provider health.
proof: Read-only aggregation in the Core from the canonical log on request (no second store, no sampling), rendered by the desktop and the CLI from the same view.
negative_proof: The desktop dashboard is asserted against the CLI's reading of the same Core, so a renderer computing its own numbers would disagree; unpriced calls are counted as unpriced, never as zero cost.
limitations: Per session only (no fleet-wide or cross-tenant dashboard, no OpenTelemetry export); not every docs/34 metric is on the view; cost shown only when a registry priced the calls; the last 20 failures.

ci.note: all jobs green on macOS, Linux and Windows; the Windows desktop E2E job was re-run once after the VS Code download aborted with ECONNRESET
